title: First run, who's learning
note: First run's one step (UXS-10 step 1, TABLE PLT-17a, JM-D15): a first name or nickname, a date of birth that only confirms the learner is 18 or over, the line that everything stays on this computer, and "Start learning". Nothing else is asked.
expectText: Everything stays on this computer unless you turn on online features later.
